title: Incremental cache (.ilk) can serve stale code silently
content: When MSVC incremental linker reuses old code despite new .obj files, strings from new code don't appear in the DLL. Diagnostic: Python binary search finds strings in .lib but not DLL = incremental link using old cache. Fix: delete .ilk file, touch tml_codegen.lib, then rebuild. This is a recurring issue when iterating on codegen — always suspect stale .ilk when new code seems to have no effect.
